## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review (`docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md`).

## Special-target verdict
Messengers was newly wired in this branch (the bug that motivated the audit). Codex review #34 added `_lastSessionStarter` / `_justLoadedFromSave` reset path. Wiring is clean; reset path is **structurally present but partially correct.**

## Findings

### P1 â€” `_justLoadedFromSave = false` set inside the `if (_lastSessionStarter != starter)` gate
- File: `Main/Features/Messengers/MessengerCampaignBehavior.cs:154-165`
- After first save-load cycle within a single campaign, the flag remains `true` for the rest of the session because the outer gate is `false` (same starter instance). No direct runtime consequence today (no consumer outside the block), but a contract violation that will mislead future authors.
- Fix: move `_justLoadedFromSave = false;` OUTSIDE the gate, unconditional at end of `OnSessionLaunched`.

### P1 â€” `_processingArrivedMessenger` permanently stuck `true` if `OpenConversationMission` returns null
- File: `Main/Features/Messengers/MessengerCampaignBehavior.cs:389`
- `_currentMission?.AddListener(this)` no-ops if mission null â†’ `OnEndMission` never fires â†’ flag never clears â†’ all future arrived-messenger processing silently blocked for the rest of the campaign session.
- Fix: null-guard after `AddListener`; if mission null, reset `_processingArrivedMessenger = false; _activeMessenger = null;` and remove messenger from store.

### P2 â€” `CampaignEvents.TickEvent.ClearListeners(this)` removes ALL TickEvent listeners on this object
- File: `Main/Features/Messengers/MessengerCampaignBehavior.cs:445`
- Currently safe (only one listener) but fragile if a future author adds a second `TickEvent` listener.
- Fix: use `RemoveNonSerializedListener(this, CleanUpSettlementEncounter)`.

### P2 â€” Dialog re-registration on a fresh `starter` instance within same campaign would silently shadow prior registrations
- Track `_dialogsRegistered` independently of `_lastSessionStarter`.

### P3 â€” `MessengerEncyclopediaMixin` uses `IoC.Resolve<>` in ctor (UIExtenderEx framework constraint â€” document the exemption inline).
### P3 â€” Wanderer with no `BornSettlement` produces self-encounter at `MessengerCampaignBehavior.cs:350-365`.

## Recurring pattern
Part of the cluster-wide R1 pattern (Reuse.Singleton + per-campaign state without explicit reset). Phase 9 should batch-fix R1 instances across NamedCompanions, HeroRace, Diplomacy, RaceAge, Siege, SpecialResources, FiefManagement, CharacterCreation.

## Test plan (when fixed)
- Unit: state machine test that simulates save â†’ load â†’ second save â†’ load â†’ assert `_justLoadedFromSave` is reset on every load.
- Integration (manual, post-fix): force `OpenConversationMission` to return null in a debug build, verify behavior recovers.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” see `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "Messengers" section. Special-target review #34 follow-up.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” `_playerModifiedIds` (singleton) carries stale exclusions across campaigns
- File: `Main/Features/BannerInjection/BannerExclusionService.cs:8`
- `BannerExclusionService` is `Reuse.Singleton`. On a new game (no save), `dataStore.SyncData("_taom_playerModifiedBanners", ref list)` leaves `list` null; the `if (list != null)` guard skips the assignment. Set persists from prior campaign. New campaign 2: TAOM canon banners not re-injected onto entities the player modified in campaign 1.
- Fix: clear on `OnNewGameCreatedEvent`, OR drop the null-guard and unconditionally assign `_playerModifiedIds = new HashSet<string>(list ?? Enumerable.Empty<string>())`.

### P1 â€” `SyncData` on a save predating this feature retains in-memory state
- File: `Main/Features/BannerInjection/BannerExclusionService.cs:26-29`
- Local `list` is initialized from current `_playerModifiedIds`. On absent-key load, the dataStore doesn't overwrite; the `if (list != null)` branch reassigns to identical state. Net: never cleared.
- Fix: initialize `list` to `null` (not from current set) so absent-key path is a no-op rather than re-assignment. Or detect via `dataStore.IsSaving`.

### P2 â€” `InvalidateVisuals` performance: large playthrough frame stutter on load
- File: `Main/Features/BannerInjection/BannerInjectionService.cs:62-63, 89-90`
- Touching all `WarPartyComponents` of every changed kingdom triggers cascading visual refreshes. Idempotency guard works correctly for already-correct entities, but post-injection load triggers per-clan invalidation.
- Fix: batch into a single post-loop pass, or defer via `CampaignEvents.TickPartialHourlyAiEvent`.

### P2 â€” `BannerConfigProvider` re-parses XML+XSLT on every call
- File: `Main/Features/BannerInjection/BannerConfigProvider.cs:24-44`
- Singleton with no cache fields. `GetKingdomBannerKeys` and `GetClanBannerKeys` open + parse files on each call. `InjectBanners` calls both per campaign event.
- Fix: lazy-initialize private dict caches.

### P3 â€” `GauntletBannerEditorScreen_OnDone_Patch._hook` static field uses null-conditional that silently swallows player banner edits if `Initialize` not yet called.

## Recurring pattern
R1 (singleton stale state across campaigns) + R2 (SyncData null-guard logic wrong).

## Test plan
- Unit: simulate two successive `SyncData` calls with different stores on same instance; assert `_playerModifiedIds` is reset on second call.
- Integration: in-game test of campaign-A â†’ main-menu â†’ campaign-B; verify TAOM banners re-injected in campaign B for entities modified in campaign A.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "BannerInjection" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P2 â€” `CharacterCreationContentService` uses sealed TaleWorlds types directly (ADR-007)
- File: `Main/Features/CharacterCreation/CharacterCreationContentService.cs:166-176, 327-332, 347`
- Direct access to `Hero.MainHero`, `MobileParty.MainParty.Position`, `Settlement.Find(...)`, `MBObjectManager.Instance.GetObject<CultureObject>(...)`. Service is untestable in isolation. Same violation class flagged in prior reviews.
- Fix: extract `IPlayerHeroAdapter.GetCulture/SetCulture/GetIsFemale`, `IPlayerPartyAdapter.SetPosition`, `ISettlementAdapter.Find`, `ICultureCreationDataProvider.GetCulture`. Inject all four.

### P2 â€” `IoC.Resolve<>` inside service body (Review #26 violation pattern)
- File: `Main/Features/CharacterCreation/CharacterCreationContentService.cs:218,235`
- `IoC.Resolve<CareerSystem.ICareerCreationHandler>()` and `IoC.Resolve<CareerSystem.ICareerRegistry>()` inside `AssignCareer()`. Memory `feedback_no_service_locator_in_services.md` codifies this as a banned pattern.
- Fix: constructor inject `ICareerCreationHandler` + `ICareerRegistry`.

### P2 â€” `CareerMenuService.SelectedCareerStringId` mutable singleton not reset between sessions
- File: `Main/Features/CharacterCreation/CareerMenuService.cs:23,68,130,164`
- Cleared only inside `RegisterCareerMenu`. If user starts â†’ abandons â†’ restarts CC without menu rebuild, stale value carries to `AssignCareer`.
- Fix: `OnSessionLaunched`-bound `ResetSession()` OR call from `TaomCharacterCreationContentHandler.InitializeContent`.

### P3 â€” `MobileParty.MainParty.Position =` lacks null-guard
- File: `Main/Features/CharacterCreation/CharacterCreationContentService.cs:327-332`
- `MobileParty.MainParty` is static prop that can return null at CC finalize time. Reachable NRE.
- Fix: add `if (MobileParty.MainParty == null) return;` or null-propagate via adapter.

## Recurring pattern
R1 (singleton state across CC sessions) + ADR-007 service-locator-in-service violations.

## Test plan
- Unit: substitute `IPlayerHeroAdapter` etc with NSubstitute, verify finalize path with no live `Hero.MainHero`.
- Integration: start new CC, abandon, start second new CC in same process â€” verify CareerMenu reset.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "CharacterCreation" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” Config `double` fields accept NaN/Infinity, no validation
- File: `Main/Features/InitialChildGeneration/InitialChildGenerationConfigProvider.cs:60-61, 79-80, 93-94`
- `FemaleRatio` (double) and `ChildCountMultiplier` (double) parsed via `defaults.Value<double?>()` with no `FiniteFloatValidator` guard, no range check (FemaleRatio 0..1; multiplier â‰¥ 0).
- IEEE-754 NaN: `_random.NextDouble() < NaN` always false â†’ all children male. `Math.Ceiling(baseCount * NaN)` â†’ NaN â†’ `(int)NaN` implementation-defined (0 in CLR).
- Memory `csharp-architecture.md` "Config Providers MUST Validate" â€” bug class has shipped 3Ã—.
- Fix: `FiniteFloatValidator.IsFiniteInRange(value, 0.0, 1.0)` for FemaleRatio; `IsFiniteAtLeast(value, 0.0)` for multiplier; same for culture/clan overrides.

### P1 â€” `SelectTemplate` throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` on zero-adult clan + FixedChildCount
- File: `Main/Features/InitialChildGeneration/InitialChildGenerationService.cs:134-137`
- Fallback path: `clan.AdultMaleHeroIds[0]` indexed when both gender lists are empty. Reachable when a clan has no adult heroes AND `FixedChildCount > 0` (config can set this).
- Fix: top-of-method guard `if (clan.AdultMaleHeroIds.Count == 0 && clan.AdultFemaleHeroIds.Count == 0) return null;` + propagate null check to `CreateChild` callsite.

### P2 â€” `OnNewGameCreatedPartialFollowUpEvent` at `index == 0` may fire before clan roster initialized
- File: `Main/Features/InitialChildGeneration/TaomInitialChildGenerationBehavior.cs:22`
- NamedCompanions uses `index == 1` â€” possibly for this reason. If clan hero rosters aren't fully populated at index 0, generation operates on empty data and silently logs success.
- Fix: verify via `ilspycmd` on SandBox what registers at index 0; bump to `index == 1` if needed.

### P2 â€” `MinAge` / `MaxAge` ints have no ordering invariant validation
- File: `Main/Features/InitialChildGeneration/InitialChildGenerationConfigProvider.cs:58-59`
- Config `min_age=15, max_age=5` causes `Random.Next(15, 6)` to throw `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`, aborting generation for all clans on the first error.
- Fix: post-parse validate `MinAge <= MaxAge`; log + revert.

### P3 â€” `SystemRandomSource` uses `System.Random` (not thread-safe in .NET 4.7.2). Latent if any future call from worker thread.
### P3 â€” Tests don't cover semantically-invalid-but-parseable values.

## Recurring pattern
R3 (config provider missing semantic validation) â€” affects InitialChildGeneration, RaceAge, Diplomacy, Siege, SpecialResources, StartupResources, CareerSystem.

## Test plan
- Unit: test cases for NaN/Infinity in `FemaleRatio` + `ChildCountMultiplier`; inverted `MinAge > MaxAge`; zero-adult clan with `FixedChildCount > 0`.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "InitialChildGeneration" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review (special target).

## Special-target verdict
**Original Review #23 bug IS fixed** â€” the traveling-with-party state is correctly handled by `IsRecruitedOrInParty` checking `PartyBelongedTo != null`. Test `EnsureCompanionsPlaced_RecruitedCompanion_SkipsPlacement` covers it.

**However: 2 NEW state-class bugs introduced.** The Entity State Matrix rule (csharp-architecture.md) requires enumerating ALL 6 states (Unrecruited, Recruited-traveling, Recruited-visiting-settlement, Dead/Disabled, Prisoner, Fugitive). The fix for Review #23 covered states 1-3 + Dead but did not extend to Prisoner / Fugitive. **This is the exact pattern the rule exists to prevent.**

## Findings

### P1 â€” `_spawned` singleton field survives across campaigns in same process
- File: `Main/Features/NamedCompanions/NamedCompanionService.cs:15,33`
- `NamedCompanionService` is `Reuse.Singleton`. `_spawned` set true on first `SpawnCompanions()`, never reset. Campaign 2 in same process: `SpawnCompanions()` returns immediately at the guard. **No companions spawn for the new campaign.**
- Fix: add `void ResetSession()` on `INamedCompanionService` setting `_spawned = false`; subscribe `OnSessionLaunchedEvent` in `NamedCompanionBehavior` to call it.

### P1 â€” Prisoner companion (mobile captor) bypasses guards and gets force-placed
- File: `Main/Adapters/NamedCompanionAdapter.cs:27-31` + `Main/Features/NamedCompanions/NamedCompanionService.cs:79`
- Prisoner companion has `PartyBelongedTo=null`, `PartyBelongedToAsPrisoner != null`, `CompanionOf` may be null (taken by AI lord), `CurrentSettlement=null` (mobile captor), `StayingInSettlement=null`. ALL guards pass.
- `PlaceInSettlement` calls `ChangeState(Active)` + `EnterSettlementAction.ApplyForCharacterOnly` â†’ corrupts prisoner state, removes them from captor's prison roster every load.
- Fix: add `IsHeroPrisoner` check to `INamedCompanionAdapter` (`hero.IsPrisoner` or `PartyBelongedToAsPrisoner != null`); skip in service before `PlaceInSettlement`.

### P1 â€” Fugitive companion unconditionally re-placed every load
- File: `Main/Adapters/NamedCompanionAdapter.cs:27-31` + `NamedCompanionService.cs:79-84`
- Fugitive: `HeroState=Fugitive`, `PartyBelongedTo=null` (cleared by `MakeHeroFugitiveAction`), `CurrentSettlement=null`, `StayingInSettlement=null`. `CompanionOf` may be null. ALL guards pass.
- `PlaceInSettlement` force-resets fugitive state to Active and teleports back to spawn settlement on every load.
- Fix: add `IsHeroFugitive` check to adapter; skip in service.

### P2 â€” Tests `EnsureCompanionsPlaced_Prisoner_SkipsPlacement` and `..._Fugitive_SkipsPlacement` are missing
- File: `TAOM.Tests/Features/NamedCompanions/NamedCompanionServiceTests.cs`
- Per `tests.md` "Skip-Guard Exhaustion (MANDATORY)": every entity state that should be skipped must have a test. Existing tests cover dead, disabled, already-placed, recruited but NOT Prisoner / Fugitive. The two missing tests would have caught both P1 bugs above.

### P2 â€” `IsRecruitedOrInParty` doesn't check `PartyBelongedToAsPrisoner`
- File: `Main/Adapters/NamedCompanionAdapter.cs:31`
- Method semantically implies "in any party"; should be broadened.
- Fix: `hero.CompanionOf != null || hero.PartyBelongedTo != null || hero.PartyBelongedToAsPrisoner != null || hero.IsPrisoner`.

### P3 â€” Config provider doesn't validate `CharacterId`/`SpawnSettlement`/`Race` for null/empty.

## Recurring pattern
R1 (`_spawned` singleton not reset) + R5 (Entity State Matrix incompletely applied â€” NamedCompanions Review #23 regression class).

## Meta-recommendation
Suggest extending `tests.md` "Skip-Guard Exhaustion" to require ALL 6 states from the Entity State Matrix to have explicit skip tests for any `EnsureXxxPlaced` / `RestoreXxx` / `EnterSettlementAction`-using path. Or add the requirement to `csharp-architecture.md` Entity State Matrix section directly.

## Test plan
- Add 2 tests: `EnsureCompanionsPlaced_PrisonerCompanion_SkipsPlacement`, `EnsureCompanionsPlaced_FugitiveCompanion_SkipsPlacement`.
- Add session-reset test for `_spawned` field.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "NamedCompanions" section. Special-target follow-up to Review #23.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review (3 behaviors).

## Findings

### P1 â€” `CareerPersistenceBehavior.SyncData` runs RestoreData unconditionally on save
- File: `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerPersistenceBehavior.cs:90`
- `dataStore.IsLoading` is never checked. The reconstruction block runs on save too: assembles `restored` from `_dataService.GetAllData()`, then calls `_dataService.RestoreData(restored)` which `_heroData = data` (replaces the dict reference). Heroes with non-empty `HeroCareerData` but empty `CareerStringId` are dropped. More importantly, any in-flight mutations to the OLD `_heroData` dict are lost mid-save (other behaviors' SyncData calls between SyncData fan-out).
- Fix: gate the reconstruct block on `if (dataStore.IsLoading)`.

### P2 â€” `CareerConfigProvider.ParseFloat` lacks NaN/Infinity guard for non-Cooldown floats
- File: `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerConfigProvider.cs:427-433`
- Only `CooldownSeconds` got the Career #31 NaN fix (via dedicated `ParseGlobalTuning`). Generic `ParseFloat` is bare `float.TryParse` for `Duration`, `Radius`, `MaxCharge`, `DamageBonus`, `DamageReduction`, all `*Tuning` floats. NaN propagates: `ExpiresAt = currentTime + NaN` â†’ `IsExpired` always false â†’ contexts never expire. NaN `Radius` â†’ all distance comparisons false â†’ zero agents affected.
- Memory: `feedback_clamp_nan_infinity_propagates.md`.
- Fix: helper-level `FiniteFloatValidator.IsFinite` check before returning.

### P2 â€” `CareerAbilityService._abilities` Singleton not cleared between campaigns
- File: `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerAbilityService.cs:11`
- `ClearAll()` called only in `OnEndMission` (Patch27 territory). New campaign 2 with same hero StringId reuses cached `CareerAbility` with old `CooldownDuration` baked in.
- Fix: inject `ICareerAbilityService` into `CareerCampaignBehavior`; call `ClearAll()` in `OnSessionLaunched`.

### P2 â€” `CareerSwitchDialogueBehavior` presents implicit career switch (no confirmation)
- File: `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerSwitchDialogueBehavior.cs:73-83`
- If `CanSwitch` returns true for multiple careers, `CareerSwitchCondition` `break`s on first eligible and stores in `_pendingNewCareerId`; Consequence executes immediately. Player has no idea which career they switched to.
- Fix: intermediate dialog showing candidate `DisplayName`, OR guard switch to single-eligible-career case.

### P3 â€” Dialog re-registration risk on save-load mid-campaign (depends on vanilla dedup behavior).
### P3 â€” `OnHeroKilled` skips `Hero.MainHero`, leaving orphan career data on character death.

## Recurring pattern
R2 (SyncData mutates on save) + R1 (AbilityService cache stale) + R3 (NaN config validation gap).

## Test plan
- Unit: SyncData round-trip test (save â†’ modify dict â†’ save again â†’ verify dict preserved).
- Unit: NaN inputs to ability templates; assert rejection with warning.
- Integration: campaign 1 â†’ main menu â†’ campaign 2; verify career ability cooldown is fresh in campaign 2.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "CareerSystem" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review (DiplomacyBehavior + WarOfTheRingBehavior).

## Findings

### P1 â€” `WarOfTheRingService.CurrentPhase` is unserialized singleton state
- File: `Main/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingService.cs:16` + `Main/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingBehavior.cs:24`
- `WarOfTheRingService` is `Reuse.Singleton`. `CurrentPhase` initializes to `WarPhase.Peace` at field declaration. `WarOfTheRingBehavior.SyncData` is empty body â€” `CurrentPhase` never persisted.
- `OnSessionLaunched` re-derives via two sequential non-nested `if` checks. For any campaign past `phase2Day`, BOTH transitions fire on every load (Peace â†’ IsengardWar â†’ FullWar). Currently idempotent (`!AreAtWar` guards), but **latent design fault:** any non-idempotent side effect added later (influence rewards, story flags, banner changes, campaign notifications) replays on every load.
- Shipped config has both phase triggers at day 1, so this fires on every load past day 1.
- Fix: persist `CurrentPhase` in `WarOfTheRingBehavior.SyncData` with key `"WarOfTheRing_CurrentPhase"`; in `CheckPhaseTransition` skip transitions for already-attained phases (distinguish "advancing to" from "already at").

### P2 â€” `WarOfTheRingConfigProvider` lacks semantic validation
- File: `Main/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingConfigProvider.cs:34-36`
- Per `csharp-architecture.md` "Config Providers MUST Validate":
  - `Phase1.TriggerDay <= 0` would fire Phase 1 on day 0 (new game start)
  - `Phase2.TriggerDay <= Phase1.TriggerDay` violates ordering invariant
  - Empty attacker/defender strings would call `DeclareWar("", "")` 
- Shipped config has `Phase2.TriggerDay == Phase1.TriggerDay == 1` (technically violates the invariant; works only because both `if` checks pass on same tick â€” possibly unintentional).
- Fix: post-deserialize validation: `phase1Day >= 1`, `phase2Day > phase1Day`, non-empty strings; log + revert on violation.

### P2 â€” `DiplomacyConfigProvider` and `WarOfTheRingConfigProvider` lack `?? new T()` fallback
- File: `Main/Features/Diplomacy/DiplomacyConfigProvider.cs:34` + `WarOfTheRingConfigProvider.cs:34`
- `JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<T>(json)` returns null for null-literal JSON. `DiplomacyService` ctor immediately calls `config.Relationships` â†’ NRE crashes mod startup. Every other config provider in TAOM uses the `?? new T()` fallback (cf. BattleBalanceConfigProvider, RevoltTuningConfigProvider, SiegeDefenseConfigProvider).
- Fix: append `?? new DiplomacyConfig()` and `?? new WarOfTheRingConfig()` to both deserialize calls.

### P3 â€” `GetEffectivePhaseDays` precedence inversion: when MCM TestMode is OFF, JSON TestMode wins anyway.
### P3 (out of scope) â€” `Patch11_Diplomacy` / `Patch12_WarOfTheRing` re-applied on every `OnGameInitializationFinished`.
### P3 (out of scope) â€” `AllianceCampaignBehavior_EndAlliance_Patch.Initialize` called twice with different args at `SubModule.cs:126-129`.

## Recurring pattern
R2 (CurrentPhase unsaved â†’ re-derived destructively) + R3 (config validation missing).

## Test plan
- Unit: round-trip CurrentPhase across save-load with mock IDataStore.
- Unit: validation rejection for `phase2Day <= phase1Day`, `phase1Day < 1`.
- Unit: null-literal JSON returns default config without NRE.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "Diplomacy" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” `_heroRaceMap` singleton not reset between campaigns in same process
- File: `Main/Features/HeroRace/RacePersistenceService.cs:13`
- `RacePersistenceService` is `Reuse.Singleton`. `_heroRaceMap` initialized once at field declaration. New campaign 2 in same process: TaleWorlds `dataStore.SyncData("_taom_heroRaceMap", ref _heroRaceMap)` for an absent key (fresh save with no prior key) leaves the ref unchanged â†’ prior campaign's map carries over â†’ `RestoreHeroRaces` overwrites new campaign's heroes with old race assignments for any colliding `StringId` (every common vanilla lord uses stable IDs like `lord_1_1`).
- This affects HeroRace + downstream consumers: Patch3_SetRace, Patch5_FaceGen, Patch9_RaceFilter, Patch29_CCBodyProperties, RaceAge, NamedCompanions all read race state and will be silently wrong.
- Fix: add `public void ResetForNewCampaign() { _heroRaceMap = new(); }`; subscribe `OnNewGameCreatedEvent` in `RacePersistenceBehavior` to call it.

### P2 â€” `HeroRosterAdapter.GetAllAliveHeroRaces` missing `?.` on computed property
- File: `Main/Adapters/HeroRosterAdapter.cs:12`
- `h.CharacterObject.Race` â€” `Hero.CharacterObject` is computed property, can be null in transient states. NRE during `OnBeforeSaveEvent` aborts the save with no recovery path.
- `SetHeroRace` at line 27 same issue.
- Adapters rule (`adapters.md`) mandates `?.` for computed TaleWorlds properties.
- Fix: `h.CharacterObject?.Race ?? 0` in get; `if (hero?.CharacterObject != null)` in set.

### P2 â€” `CaptureHeroRaces` excludes race `0` (human) from snapshot â€” asymmetric restore loses intentional resets
- File: `Main/Features/HeroRace/RacePersistenceService.cs:30`
- The `if (hero.Race > 0)` guard skips humans to keep map small. But: a hero deliberately reset to human (race 0) by Patch3_SetRace, CharacterCreation, NamedCompanions doesn't get captured. On next load, the stale non-human entry from the prior capture is restored, silently reverting the human assignment.
- Fix: capture all races including 0 (cost: one `int` per hero); OR explicitly remove stale map entries for heroes whose current race is 0.

### P3 â€” Tests don't cover `RegisterEvents` wiring (silent inert if subscriptions removed).
### P3 â€” `CapturedRaceCount` not on `IRacePersistenceService` interface; tests bind to concrete.
### P3 (out of scope) â€” `HeroRaceIoC.cs:18-19` calls `Initialize(eyeHeightHook)` from inside IoC registration.

## Recurring pattern
R1 (singleton state stale across campaigns) â€” affects 8 features in this cluster. Phase 9 should batch-fix.

## Cross-feature impact
HeroRace's race state is consumed by 6 other systems. A stale map at load corrupts ALL of them silently.

## Test plan
- Unit: simulate two `SyncData` cycles with different stores; assert `_heroRaceMap` cleared on second.
- Unit: NRE-safe path with null `CharacterObject`.
- Unit: round-trip race=0 (human) â€” should preserve, not lose.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "HeroRace" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” `TaomPregnancyModel.GetDailyChanceOfPregnancyForHero` contains 32 lines of inline business logic (ADR-007 + GameModel rule double-violation)
- File: `Main/Features/RaceAge/Models/TaomPregnancyModel.cs:18-58`
- The override accesses sealed `Hero` directly: `hero.Clan.Tier`, `hero.Clan.AliveLords`, `hero.Children`, `hero.Spouse`, `hero.CharacterObject.Race`. Uses `Math.Min`, `ExplainedNumber`, `GetPerkValue`. Full vanilla pregnancy reimplementation. No delegation.
- Per `csharp-architecture.md` GameModel rule: "a body that contains `if`, `foreach`, `switch`, `yield` branching, or any multi-line computation is a violation â€” extract to a service."
- Memory: `feedback_gamemodel_inline_logic.md`.
- This is technically Phase 2 (GameModel) territory, flagged here because it's directly tied to the RaceAge service.
- Fix: extract `float GetDailyPregnancyChance(IHeroAgeInfo)` to `IRaceAgeService`; convert `Hero` â†’ adapter at GameModel boundary; one-line delegation.

### P1 â€” `RaceAgeService._raceIdCache` Singleton never cleared between campaigns
- File: `Main/Features/RaceAge/RaceAgeService.cs:11`
- `RaceAgeService` is `Reuse.Singleton`. `_raceIdCache` populated lazily on first `GetEntry`. If race integer IDs shift between campaign starts (which the HeroRace P1 above can cause), cache serves entries mapped from old integerâ†’name pairings to wrong `RaceAgeEntry`.
- Fix: `OnSessionLaunched`-triggered `Reset()` on `IRaceManager`, OR promote `_raceIdCache` to per-call local rather than singleton field.

### P2 â€” `RaceAgeConfigProvider.LoadConfig` has no semantic validation
- File: `Main/Features/RaceAge/RaceAgeConfigProvider.cs:34` + `RaceAgeConfig.cs`
- `FertilityMod` (float) accepts NaN/Infinity â†’ `baseChance *= NaN` â†’ ExplainedNumber returns NaN â†’ vanilla dice roll undefined.
- `MaxAge`/`BecomeOld`/`ComesOfAge`/`MiddleAge`/`FertilityEnd` ints have no ordering invariants (e.g., `ComesOfAge < FertilityEnd < MaxAge`). Inverted ordering produces negative fertility windows â†’ garbage rates.
- R3 pattern; bug class has shipped 3Ã—.
- Fix: per-entry `FiniteFloatValidator` for FertilityMod; ordering invariants for ages; log + revert per `csharp-architecture.md` mandate.

### P2 â€” `RaceAgeService.GetEntry` calls `GetRaceNameFromId(raceId)` without prior `IsValidRaceId` validation
- File: `Main/Features/RaceAge/RaceAgeService.cs:47-49`
- `RaceManager.GetRaceNameFromId` returns "human" fallback for invalid IDs. `GetEntry` then `_races.TryGetValue("human", ...)` â†’ silently treats invalid race as human for all age calculations.
- Memory: `feedback_validate_before_lookup_with_fallback.md` â€” exact pattern from Codex review #33 in CharacterCreation.
- Fix: validate via `_raceManager.IsValidRaceId(raceId)` BEFORE the lookup; return `_defaultEntry` directly on invalid; cache under sentinel key to avoid log spam.

### P3 â€” `_deathList` instance field unnecessary (style only).
### P3 (out of scope) â€” `TaomAgeModel.MaxAge` / `BecomeOldAge` hardcoded constants (`10000` / `5000`). Phase 4 GameModel territory.

## Recurring pattern
R1 (singleton race cache) + R3 (config validation) + R4 (validate-before-lookup) â€” three patterns in one feature.

## Test plan
- Unit: NaN `FertilityMod` rejection.
- Unit: `MaxAge < ComesOfAge` rejection.
- Unit: invalid raceId returns default entry (not "human" entry).
- Unit: cache reset across two campaigns in same process.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "RaceAge" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” Complete save-loss of all active siege defense events
- File: `Main/Features/Siege/SiegeDefenseBehavior.cs:29` (empty SyncData) + `SiegeDefenseService.cs:30`
- `SiegeDefenseBehavior.SyncData` is **empty body**: `public override void SyncData(IDataStore dataStore) { }`.
- `_activeEvents` is a Singleton dict of `ActiveSiegeDefenseEvent` records carrying `CampaignTime Deadline`, `PlayerAccepted`, `RewardClaimed` flags. **Never serialized.**
- After save-load with active siege: dictionary empty. The siege continues in-world (`OnSiegeEventStartedEvent` already fired and won't re-fire), but no entry exists to match in `OnHourlyTick` â†’ no re-inquiry, no reward delivery, and the VisualTracker registration leaks (no `UntrackSettlement`).
- **Most user-visible bug in the cluster.** First save-load with an active siege loses all in-flight defense state.
- Fix: implement `SyncData` properly. Serialize `_activeEvents` with stable key `"SiegeDefenseActiveEvents"`. On load, re-register VisualTracker entries for events where `PlayerAccepted && !RewardClaimed`.

### P1 â€” `_activeEvents` singleton not reset on new campaign in same process
- File: `Main/Features/Siege/SiegeDefenseService.cs:30`
- R1 pattern. New campaign 2 inherits `_activeEvents` from campaign 1. Stale events suppress new events for matching settlement IDs (line 54: `IsWatchedSiege` returns false for keys already in dict). Could spuriously deliver rewards or skip new sieges.
- Fix: `OnSessionLaunched` â†’ `Reset()` clearing `_activeEvents`.

### P2 â€” `CampaignTime.DaysFromNow` exception swallowed silently, sets deadline to `default(CampaignTime)`
- File: `Main/Features/Siege/SiegeDefenseService.cs:93-100`
- `CampaignTime` defaults to `long` zero (campaign epoch â€” instantly past). Bare `catch` block sets `deadline = default`. The next hourly tick fires line 150 (`deadline.IsPast && !RewardClaimed`) â†’ event cleaned up before player can respond. Exception not even logged.
- Fix: remove try/catch, or log at Error level + fall back to `CampaignTime.DaysFromNow(3)` (MCM default).

### P2 â€” Dead config fields `RelationshipThreshold` and `ResponseWindowDays` declared but never consumed
- File: `Main/Features/Siege/Models/SiegeDefenseConfig.cs:9-10` + grep across codebase confirms zero callsites
- The deadline uses `_settings.SiegeDefenseResponseDays` (MCM, not JSON `ResponseWindowDays`); no relationship-threshold gate exists. R3 pattern + Simplicity Criterion violation per `simplicity-criterion.md`.
- User can edit JSON expecting effect; nothing happens.
- Fix: either wire both fields (use `ResponseWindowDays` as MCM-fallback; implement relationship-threshold filter in `IsWatchedSiege`) OR delete from config model + JSON.

### P2 â€” Reward delivery race: siege ends just before player arrives
- File: `Main/Features/Siege/SiegeDefenseService.cs:174-175`
- `GrantReward` requires `settlement.SiegeEvent != null`. If siege resolves between hourly ticks while player is en route, `OnSiegeEnded` fires and removes the `_activeEvents` entry; reward not granted. Design intent ("reward for showing up") not fulfilled.
- Fix: also grant reward in `OnSiegeEnded` when `PlayerAccepted && !RewardClaimed && playerAtSettlement`.

### P3 â€” `RewardRelation`/`RewardInfluence` lack semantic validation (R3).

## Recurring pattern
R2 (empty SyncData) + R1 (singleton not reset) + R3 (config validation gaps).

## Test plan
- Unit: SyncData round-trip for `_activeEvents`.
- Integration: save during active siege; load; verify event re-restored, VisualTracker re-registered.
- Unit: campaign 1 â†’ campaign 2 in same process; verify `_activeEvents` empty in campaign 2.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "Siege" section.

## Source
TAOM feature audit Phase 3 â€” CampaignBehavior cluster review.

## Findings

### P1 â€” `SyncData` clamps ALL keys with single resource cap, corrupting multi-resource saves
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourcesBehavior.cs:57-64`
- `_storage.ClampAll(resource.Cap)` is called with the player's CURRENT resource cap. `ClampAll` applies that single cap to every key in the dict, regardless of which resource the key represents.
- On any save with multiple hero IDs or multi-resource state: `gems` values (cap 600) get clamped to `war_spoils` cap (500); `elven_wine` clamped to 500 instead of 400; etc.
- Even today, every hero with a different resource than the player is clamped to wrong cap on every save-load.
- **Additional concern:** `SyncData` should be a pure round-trip (serialize or deserialize), not a mutation step. Mutating in `SyncData` is non-idempotent â€” permanently alters data on every save cycle.
- Fix: remove `ClampAll` from `SyncData`. Per-resource cap inside `RestoreData` per-key (parse composite key to extract resourceId, look up resource cap).

### P1 â€” `ScreenManager.OnPushScreen += OnScreenPushed` never unsubscribed (event leak across campaigns)
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourcesBehavior.cs:46`
- `ScreenManager` is a static/global object outliving any campaign. New campaign in same process: second behavior instance registers another listener. First instance's listener still alive, calling `_service.BeginPartyScreenSession()` on shared singleton service â†’ resets `_pendingSpend` and `_inSession` for new campaign's party-screen sessions, potentially cancelling legitimate pending spends.
- Listeners accumulate over multi-campaign sessions.
- Fix: subscribe `CampaignEvents.OnSessionEndedEvent` in `RegisterEvents`, implement `OnSessionEnded` to `ScreenManager.OnPushScreen -= OnScreenPushed`.

### P1 â€” `ParseFloat` throws on malformed XML + lacks NaN/Infinity validation
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourceConfigProvider.cs:195-198`
- Uses `float.Parse(val, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)` with no `TryParse` guard. A malformed value (`cap="abc"`) throws `FormatException` â†’ bubbles to outer catch â†’ silently zeroes ALL resources for the entire file.
- More critically: `float.Parse("NaN")` returns `float.NaN`. `cap="NaN"` makes `Math.Min(cap, val)` return NaN for every entry, collapsing all balances. `FiniteFloatValidator` exists in codebase, unused here.
- R3 pattern.
- Fix: replace with `float.TryParse` + `FiniteFloatValidator.IsFinite` checks + range validation (cap > 0, rates â‰¥ 0).

### P2 â€” Singleton fields `_loggedResolveKeys` + `_pendingSpend` + `_inSession` not reset on new campaign
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourceService.cs:16,34`
- R1 pattern. `_pendingSpend` from prior session can deduct against new hero's balance if `_inSession=true` carries over.
- Fix: `OnNewGameCreatedEvent` (already subscribed) â†’ `_loggedResolveKeys.Clear(); _pendingSpend = 0f; _inSession = false;` OR expose `ResetSessionState()`.

### P2 â€” Desertion fires immediately on first DailyTickHero after load if balance was 0 pre-save
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourcesBehavior.cs:114-125`
- No grace period. R5 pattern (Entity State Matrix not applied to load-path mutation).
- Player loads a save where they had 0 balance â†’ first daily tick after load fires desertion before the player has a chance to earn income.
- Fix: `_isFirstTickAfterLoad` flag set in `SyncData` (or `OnSessionLaunched`); skip desertion branch when true; clear at end of OnDailyTickHero.

### P2 â€” `OnSessionLaunched` legacy-save seeding fires on every kingdom-change
- File: `Main/Features/SpecialResources/SpecialResourcesBehavior.cs:82-91`
- Player switches Gondor (Castar) â†’ Mordor (War Spoils): `OnSessionLaunched` sees balance=0 for War Spoils (new slot) and seeds `StartingAmount`. Bypasses "earn it" progression.
- Fix: gate seeding on versioned SyncData flag (`_taom_specialResources_seeded`) written once on `OnNewGameCreated` + first session-launched seed; checked on subsequent sessions.

### P3 (out of scope) â€” Patch26 `SetTotalNumber` reflection field cached on first use rather than `Initialize`.

## Recurring pattern
R1 + R2 + R3 + R5 â€” four patterns in one feature.

## Test plan
- Unit: multi-resource SyncData round-trip; verify per-resource caps preserved.
- Unit: campaign 1 â†’ campaign 2 ScreenManager listener count = 1 (not 2).
- Unit: malformed XML doesn't zero file; NaN cap rejected.
- Unit: load with balance=0 doesn't trigger immediate desertion.

## Phase reference
Phase 3 cluster review â€” `docs/audits/cluster-campaign-behaviors.md` "SpecialResources" section.
